name: Photonworks Engineering
old_description: Start Saving now with Hawaii's Best Energy Contractor for the last 18 Years
about:
Photonworks Engineering is based in Honolulu, Hawaii, and was founded in 2003 by Tim Johnsson. Johnsson, a recipient of the ABC 2010 Excellence in Construction Award for multi-family developments, established the company to connect people with cheaper and cleaner sources of power while preserving Hawaii’s natural beauty. The firm operates as a local design-build renewable energy contractor with a team that includes CEO Paul Orem, a licensed journeyman electrician and general contractor with 25 years of experience, and COO Randall Bricker, who brings 28 years in development and engineering across federal, state, and private sectors.

The company provides end-to-end energy solutions: solar photovoltaic design and installation, battery energy storage systems, microgrid engineering, full-service electrical construction, energy efficiency retrofits, PV system monitoring and maintenance, and eco-friendly development. Photonworks handles site assessment, engineering, permitting, construction, commissioning, and long-term operations and maintenance, offering up to two years of no-charge O&M after installation. It also structures power purchase agreements with zero capital expense and zero-down financing. The firm reports serving thousands of customers across Hawaii and beyond, with a project portfolio that includes commercial, institutional, and government sites.

Photonworks serves residential homeowners, commercial property owners, educational institutions, non-profits, and government agencies. Named projects include Hanalani Schools, Boys and Girls Club of Hawaii, Joint Base Pearl Harbor, Aiea Public Library, Kailua Waste Water Facility, Kahauiki Village, Hawaii Pacific University, Century West, USSF Space Fence, and the Board of Water Supply. The company works closely with Hawaiian Electric (HECO) on interconnection agreements and grid services.

Photonworks states its differentiator is a commitment to being the best rather than the biggest, emphasizing that most residential clients come from referrals and commercial clients are repeat customers. The mission is to exceed expectations through one-stop engineering-to-construction solutions, straightforward technical staff rather than salespeople, and a focus on energy autonomy and resilience for Hawaii’s transition to 100% renewable energy.
